exposure: Mode of delivery (caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Early initiation of breastfeeding (within one hour of delivery)
Exclusive breastfeeding during the first three days following birth
cohort: 777 primiparae women with a singleton birth from the 2013 Turkey Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Women who underwent caesarean section had a higher risk of late initiation of breastfeeding and non-exclusive breastfeeding during the three days following delivery, after controlling for sociodemographic and delivery-related factors.
mod_finding: Women who underwent caesarean section had a higher risk of late initiation of breastfeeding and non-exclusive breastfeeding during the three days following delivery.
